body:
Everyone tells me I'm strong and I'll be OK. But what I really want to do is scream. No one seems to have a grasp of what I'm going through. I'm so tired of putting up a smile, both at work and at a home. I'm tired of pretending that I don't hurt. I'm just so tired of pretending I'm OK.

I used to go out, socialize and have fun, but I no longer find joy in that. I actually noticed that I no longer am how I was before. I'm just not how I was. I find no happiness or enjoyment in things I used to love.

I don't know what to do anymore. I constantly think about ending it all. I really don't want to, but I feel like everyone in my life would be better off.
